title: Headless You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head (MS14, TTW 3.4): from Mister Crowley's contract to the three keys handed over (stage 100)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed]. MS14 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player meets Mister Crowley in Underworld.

Path (Crowley's contract, all four killed): Crowley's talk to his offer (MS14NoOffense, MS14WhatOffer, MS14CanKill sets CrowleyOffer) and the job taken (MS14TakeQuest: stage 10, a sniper rifle, the targets' objectives); Dukov, Ted Strayer, Dave and Allistair Tenpenny are killed and the three keys taken from the bodies; once the player has left Underworld (LieTimer 2) Crowley is told Tenpenny is dead (MS14GotTenpennyDead) and given each key (MS14GotKeys: NumKeys); his goodbye with all three keys sets 100 (reward, Crowley leaves for Fort Constantine, MS14Fin starts). Other endings: the T-51b armor taken first (200), Crowley killed before the keys (255). [observed: MS14 stage and INFO scripts on the TTW load order]
Stand-in for the walk to Dukov (in his place by the Georgetown ruins) and the fight; the key is taken from the body (the pilot searches it).
Stand-in for the walk to Ted Strayer (at the Chevy Chase houses) and the fight; the key is taken from the body (the pilot searches it).
Stand-in for the walk to Dave (in the Republic of Dave) and the fight; the key is taken from the body (the pilot searches it).
Stand-in for the way up Tenpenny Tower to the penthouse and the fight with Allistair Tenpenny.

Stand-in for the walk back to Underworld. Crowley's greeting asks for proof; Tenpenny's death is told, then each key handed over (each MS14GotKeys line is Say Once); his goodbye with all three keys sets 100.
